option_relations.rationale: Frontotemporal Dementia (FTD) is a broader category that can encompass ALS-FTD spectrum disorder, but it is not equivalent to the specific TBK1-related disorder.

Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis–Frontotemporal Dementia (ALS-FTD) is a broader category that can encompass TBK1-related ALS-FTD spectrum disorder, but it is not equivalent to the specific TBK1-related disorder.
Frontotemporal lobar degeneration–motor neuron disease (FTLD-MND) is a broader category that can encompass ALS-FTD spectrum disorder, but it is not equivalent to the specific TBK1-related disorder.
The option 'Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis-frontotemporal dementia (ALS-FTD) spectrum disorder (TBK1-related)' is clinically equivalent to the leaf 'TBK1-related ALS-FTD spectrum disorder'.
